name: Red Wine Bosc Pear Salad with Gorgonzola & Candied Pecans
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Pears are high in excess fructose/sorbitol (FODMAPs) and the salad is topped with sharp candied pecans and raw frisée greens.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares; if tasting in remission, eat a few bites of poached pear only and skip all candied pecans and raw greens.
